'''Orbital Commerce''' was a ministry operating on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tallaan]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. One of the most powerful ministries, it controlled the civilian [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyards]] and oversaw the daily financial transactions that took place on any orbital station above the world.<ref name="LE" />
